knowledge.the_winter_rescue.refractory_b: An Idea for Refractory Firing

These materials and refractory products suggest improving bricks through controlled firing. Try linking an item observation of a sandy brick or sandy brick block; kaolin, bauxite and clay ball observations make the puzzle easier.
Ordinary Refractory Bricks

Build a Controlled Furnace and fire Fire Clay Balls at different temperatures. Observe the resulting Refractory Brick to find a suitable firing method.
Finishing unlocks batch brick production in this furnace. Find equipment and material recipes in JEI.
Learned a kaolin material observation
Learned a bauxite material observation
Learned clay ball observation

Link an item observation of a sandy brick or sandy brick block. Learned kaolin, bauxite and clay ball observations each remove one ordered number; placing them on the tray is also allowed. Each material group counts once.
Controlled Refractory Batch Production

Normally learned automatically, this design enables 16 fire clay balls and 2 charcoal to produce 16 ordinary refractory bricks in the controlled furnace. It only unlocks the new batch process. Existing pottery, blast furnace, industrial kiln and block recipes remain unchanged. It does not unlock high refractory bricks or the IE blast furnace.
Prepare Materials and Equipment
Prepare a Fire Clay Ball, charcoal and a Controlled Furnace

1. Prepare the powders. Thaw frozen kaolin and bauxite at a campfire. Break bauxite with a stone hammer on a stump, then grind it on a millstone; kaolin can be ground directly.
2. Mix 4 kaolin dust, 4 bauxite dust and 1 clay ball in a crafting table to make a Fire Clay Ball.
3. Craft a Controlled Furnace from 6 clay balls, 2 sand and 1 campfire; see JEI for the layout. Bring 1 charcoal.
When ready, click Enter Next Stage to begin firing.
You can begin firing. Observing an existing refractory brick helps narrow the temperature range.
Fire and Observe
Test-fire a brick in the Controlled Furnace

1. Open the Controlled Furnace, select Trial mode and insert 1 Fire Clay Ball and 1 charcoal.
2. Try a temperature between 1000 and 1200 C; 1100 C is a useful starting point. Click Start, wait 20 seconds and collect the sample. If it is a Cracked Refractory Brick, adjust the temperature and try again with fresh materials.

1. Open the Controlled Furnace, select Trial mode and insert 1 Fire Clay Ball and 1 charcoal.
2. Your existing brick observations suggest 1050 to 1150 C, inclusive; try 1100 C. Click Start, wait 20 seconds and collect the sample.
